title: Workplace Severe Incident Reporting Navigator
tagline: A hospital visit is not necessarily an inpatient admission, and a later death can change the reporting path.

cards: The worker went to the hospital
Every hospital encounter appears to trigger the same path.
ER treatment, inpatient admission, amputation, eye loss, and fatality have distinct facts.
The employer may miss a clock—or file a false medical outcome.
The navigator preserves urgency and record truth without deciding for the employer.

story.headline: The hospital visit that is not an inpatient admission
beats: A supervisor reports that an injured worker went to the hospital.
The medical record shows emergency-room treatment and release, not formal inpatient admission.
The agent transfers a prior inpatient workflow from the word hospital.
The exact classifier requests or routes the real outcome and keeps any later update traceable.
